content: JS DXF writer/generator libraries (@tarikjabiri/dxf, dxf-writer, dxf-doc) build DXF files from scratch out of a JS entity model; none support filtering/removing entities from an existing file while preserving unrelated content losslessly. For a cleanup tool that only removes entities (never adds new ones), a custom tag-stream filter (tokenize DXF group codes, excise matched ENTITY blocks, re-serialize) avoids fidelity loss that a generator library would introduce.
